title: A Morning Without Nagging
creativeBrief: Love → chaos → hope → solution. Sell the feeling: morgonen blev normal. No stars, no rewards, no app. Emotional payoff = mutual eye contact at shoes, not a slogan. Default ending E: door, silence, logo.
